ranking.name: Water leaving the land (evapotranspiration)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, water leaving the land (evapotranspiration) in the Indian subcontinent changed by +0.123 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval +0.068 to +0.184), which is statistically significant (p < 0.001). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.303 mm/day.

cautions: The confidence interval is wide compared with the trend, so the size of the change is uncertain.
ranking.name: Rain and snow (precipitation)
ranking.sentence: From January 2001 to September 2025, rain and snow (precipitation) in the Indian subcontinent changed by +0.17 mm/day per decade (95% confidence interval +0.04 to +0.30), which is statistically significant (p = 0.0075). Over the whole 24.7-year period that is an increase of about 0.43 mm/day.
